_note: All lines here are Proposed placeholders. Yak writes each NPC's personal lines; shared templates cover rumors, guide hire, wagers and invitations. {name} {creature} {place} {token} {fee} are filled from game data.
rumor: "They say a {creature} keeps to the {place}. I would not go alone."
"I heard a {creature} out in the {place} not long ago."
guide_offer: "I can take you to the {creature} in the {place} for {fee} gold."
guide_refuse: "Not today. I have my own day to see to."
wager_decline: "Not for a token. A plain game, if you like."
wager_none: "You have nothing in that pouch to stake."
after_loss: "Mine now. Lose a wagered token and it is gone."
away: {name} is not interested in Dya'Akara and has other things to do.
